#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    
    std::vector<long long> prev(n + 1, 0);
    prev[0] = 1;
    
    long long tWays = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; ++i) {
        std::vector<long long> cur(n + 1, 0);
        if (n >= 1) cur[0] = prev[1];
        if (n >= 1) cur[n] = prev[n - 1];
        for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
            cur[k] = (prev[k - 1] + prev[k + 1]) % MOD;
        }
        prev = cur;
        
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            int limit = std::min(i, 2 * n - i);
            for (int k = 0; k <= limit; ++k) {
                tWays = (tWays + prev[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << tWays << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
